description: We’re curious problem-solvers tackling Be An Earth System Trend Detective! We’ll dig into NASA Earth data (temperature, vegetation, sea ice, air quality), find trends that matter, and turn them into clear interactive visuals. We’re friendly, organised and here to build something real. Looking for: Python/data analysis, data visualisation, front-end dev, Earth/climate science knowledge, and pitch/storytelling skills. Beginners welcome!
